dropped_fields.reason: A boolean doesn't map directly to a serial number profile code (MARC-SERNP) -- 'true' needs to resolve to an actual configured profile in the target system, not just a flag.

SAP has no single 'active' flag on the material master, only block/deletion indicators at different scopes (MARA-LVORM cross-plant vs. MARC-LVORM per-plant). All 100 rows are True in this data, giving no evidence of which one 'inactive' would need to mean -- same open question as Customers>Is_Active, needs a business decision before mapping.
